title: Decoding News Bias: Multi Bias Detection in News Articles
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious bias in news articles, defined as the unfair favoring or critique of a particular religion or its followers, or unfairly portraying certain faiths as superior or inferior.
findings: Religious bias was one of seven categories evaluated. Transformer models were tested on its detection, with BERT achieving the highest F1-score (0.89). A key finding was the unreliability of the annotating LLM (GPT-4omini) for this category; it often misclassified articles as biased simply for mentioning religious practices or events (e.g., a Hindu ritual or a bomb threat at a religious site) without any actual prejudice being present, indicating a difficulty in distinguishing neutral reporting from biased content.
